title: On the Art of the No Drama: The Major Treatises of Zeami

publication.edition: Translations of the major treatises, including Fushikaden/Kadensho; reissued 2020

verification.verification_notes: Translators, publisher, and 1984 date verified via Open Library. Used for yugen (profound grace and subtlety; the beauty of what is only suggested) and the Noh aesthetics of restraint and implicit meaning; the Kuscholarworks essay 'Zeami and the Transition of the Concept of Yugen' corroborates the interpretation of yugen as beyond statement yet of this world.

translation.translator: J. Thomas Rimer and Masakazu Yamazaki
limitations: Yugen's acoustic and imagistic texture is not fully recoverable in English; the dossier claims the aesthetics of suggestion, not exact terminology.

copyright.notes: Treatises public domain; Rimer/Yamazaki translation copyrighted; analytical citation only; no passages reproduced.
